answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the willow log publishes the live set and the ocean audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 155 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 204 aliases alive therefore means 204 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the sparrow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
